thread:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a weird KV pagetable memory growth on long-context runs when routing to a mixed A100/Mi250 pool :eyes:
ajay: repro steps?
maria: quick repro: run longctx workload (10k tokens), repeated prefixes to force reuse. A100-only ok, Mi250-only ok, mixed pool shows steady GPU mem growth ~2-5%/hr until OOM.
sophie: got any kv stats / logs?
maria: kv_stats snapshot: pages_alloc=12240 evicts=3120 reuse_hits=8200 pt_shadow_writes=12 pt_walk_retries=21000
maria: also seeing log lines like: "pt_owner_mismatch slot=3456 live_owner=0x7f33 shadow_owner=0x3f22" and "evict_marked but not reclaimed slot=3456"
ajay: hmm could be kernel-selection -> different tile/stride expectations cause fragmentation or aliasing in the pagetable mapping.
dmitri: we had something similar: mi250 kernels default to 128-stride seg layout, a100 uses 256; when remap happens across GPUs shadow PT entries can be left stale.
maria: attached short repro command:```./run_longctx.sh --model llama2-7b --pool a100,mi250 --batch 1 --seq 10000 --repeat-prefix```
liam: can you enable REDWOOD_KV_PAGETABLE_DEBUG and dump the slot traces?
maria: did that. dumps include lines: "SHADOW_DIFF slot=3456 old=0x1a2b new=0x0 WARN:reclaim_pending"
"PAGEWALK FAIL slot=3456 retries=12 owner_check=failed"
ci-bot: perf-run summary: mem-growth=1.8%/hr pt-walks=22000 eviction-fail=153 (run id ci/kv-mix-3360)
sophie: short mitigation idea: force same kernel-family for paged-attn paths or avoid cross-arch routing for longctx-heavy workloads. cheap and fast.
ajay: longer-term: add atomic versioning to PT entries so remap increments version and any stale accessor sees mismatch and rechecks mapping. should avoid silently keeping stale slot metadata.
maria: tried quick patch: atomic_inc(&pt_version[slot]) on remap + check on access. local run shows mem-growth ~0.1%/hr over 2h.
dmitri: nice. open a PR so infra can run longer CI?
maria: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4528 (notes: pagetable versioning + small reclaim race fix + fuzz test).
liam: schedule full 48h perf run on mixed pool, please. also add a regression test that simulates remap under concurrent pagewalks.
maria: will enqueue job and add test to kvcache-fuzz. thanks all :thumbsup:
